jobs.description:
Our client is a leading independent Belgian full-service law firm based in Brussels, advising both national and international companies across a broad range of legal matters, transactions, and disputes.

Jobomschrijving

• Advise Belgian and international clients on individual and collective employment law matters.
• Handle complex employment-related projects, including:
• Collective dismissals
• Employment regulations and policies
• Cross-border employment issues
• Service agreements
• Employment litigation
• Social law implications of restructurings, insolvencies, and corporate transactions
• Support clients involved in mergers and acquisitions from an employment law perspective.
• Draft, review, and negotiate employment-related documentation.
• Work closely with senior lawyers, Counsel, and partners while progressively taking ownership of files.
• Provide pragmatic, business-oriented legal advice to clients across multiple sectors.

• Qualified Belgian lawyer.
• Minimum 4 years of experience in Employment/Labour Law, ideally gained in a recognized law firm.
• Strong command of Dutch, with professional fluency in French and English.
• Excellent drafting and analytical skills.
• Pragmatic, solution-driven, and client-focused mindset.
• Autonomous, confident, and able to express ideas proactively.
• Entrepreneurial attitude demonstrated through professional, academic, or extracurricular initiatives.
• International exposure or an additional relevant master's degree is considered a plus.
• Team player who thrives in a collaborative and non-competitive culture.

Our client is the European subsidiary of a global leader in advanced alloys used in high-specification industries such as aerospace, medical, and energy.
The European headquarters hosts a truly multicultural team within a friendly, people-focused environment that combines the stability of a world-class manufacturer with the agility of a rapidly scaling organisation.
 
With ambitious growth plans across Europe and an exponentially expanding customer base, the company offers significant long-term career opportunities, internal mobility prospects, and the chance to contribute to a business positioned at the forefront of technical innovation.

Jobomschrijving

While full technical training is provided, your mission will be to ensure an excellent commercial experience for European customers and supporting the full sales cycle:

• Act as the main point of contact for customers in your assigned region, ensuring accurate verbal and written communication of all requirements.
• Manage inquiries, quotations, and orders, and coordinate with production, logistics, and technical teams across Europe and the U.S.
• Organise shipments of finished goods to European customers and follow up proactively on delivery status.
• Maintain and monitor inventory levels (general, custom, and market stock) and provide recommendations to management.
• Navigate strict quality, export compliance, and internal process requirements linked to aerospace-grade products.
• Solve day-to-day issues independently, escalating only when needed.
• Participate in weekly team meetings, one-to-ones, and ongoing coaching sessions with a dedicated local trainer.
• Contribute to continuous improvement and special internal projects.

The client is not looking for someone who has done this job before, but for a high-potential personality eager to grow, learn, and take ownership. 
Personality & Attitude :

• Ambitious, eager to accelerate their career and take on more responsibility over time (leadership, global exposure, or project ownership).
• Intellectually agile, quick to absorb large amounts of technical information.
• Exceptionally organised and structured, able to prioritise in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
• Assertive and confident on the phone, someone who proactively calls stakeholders rather than relying on emails.
• Open-minded, positive, and energetic, with strong resilience and stress resistance.
• Solution-oriented, able to anticipate issues and think ahead (plan B mindset).
• Comfortable dealing with demanding or high-level stakeholders, including U.S.-based teams.
Background & Experience :

The company welcomes talent from diverse sectors or any environment requiring:

• High customer interaction
• Complex coordination
• Strong communication & reactivity
Technical & Language Skills :

• Fluent in English (C-level) is mandatory
• At least B2 level in Turkish is required for customer interactions
• Affinity with technical topics, curiosity and willingness to learn about complex products

Are you an experienced operator who is ready to take the next step in your career?
Do you already have some initial experience in leadership and are you able to motivate and guide a team of employees?

Job Description:

• You are responsible for the production line assigned to you.
• Your team consists of about 9 employees (both permanent and temporary staff).
• You motivate your entire team and ensure a positive atmosphere and strong cooperation.
• You also actively take part in the production process, monitoring and controlling it.
• You stay alert and suggest improvements.
• You are able to solve small technical issues.
• During shift changes, you are responsible for the handover.

PROFIEL

• You have experience leading a team.
• You have strong social and communication skills, allowing you to communicate effectively (also with technicians and other departments).
• Working with people of different nationalities does not intimidate you.
• You can express yourself well in English. Basic knowledge of Bulgarian or Polish is a plus.
• Your formal education is less important, but you have a strong motivation to keep learning.
• You are mature, flexible, stress-resistant, and able to work independently.

• You report to the Production Manager.

AANBOD

What do you get?

• A varied and responsible position where you get the opportunity to further develop your leadership skills.
• Work in a dynamic environment, where no two days are the same and you are constantly challenged to optimize processes and lead a motivated team.
• A commuting allowance, so you can travel to and from work comfortably and cost-effectively.

In the ever-fascinating world of technology, integration opens endless possibilities. We are here to show companies how integration can empower their digital foundations and fuel business growth. And you have the chance to be at the forefront of the fascinating world of integration with us by joining us as an Integration Engineer.

Who are we?

Meet i8c! An established value within the integration market and part of CornerBriX, the largest integration community in Belgium. i8c is an expert in Hybrid Integration Platforms (HIP), ensuring seamless collaboration between all IT-systems like mobile apps, administrative tools, CRMs, ERPs, Microservices, SaaS platforms, B2B platforms and many more for leading companies in the BeNeLux region.

At i8c, you’ll find a community of integration experts who are here to challenge you, inspire you and support you. You'll always have the freedom to choose your work location, be it at home or one of our remote co-working spaces.

What will your job look like as an Integration Engineer at i8c:

• Take end-to-end ownership for i8c projects, handling development, deployment, and operational maintenance.
• You’ll embrace DevOps principles to achieve optimal uptime and minimize incidents.

• You’ll provide support on a rotational basis as part of a 24/7 standby team, ensuring prompt assistance when required.
• You’ll participate in daily standup meetings 

Who is our i8c Integration Engineer:

• We don't require extensive experience, but eagerness to deep dive into multiple hybrid integration platforms and technologies, such as Software AG webMethods, Tibco Connect, IBM App Connect/API Connect, Microsoft BizTalk and Azure, Google Apigee, and Boomi.
• You are fluent in English, both written as oral.
• You have basic programming experience with Java or .Net, with a focus on back-end development. 
• You are familiar with the concepts and principles of networking, security (DNS, firewalls, HTTP, SSL…) and DevOps (CI/CD, testing…)
• Knowledge of Enterprise Integration Patterns is a plus, just as experience with collaboration tools such as Atlassian, GitLab,…

We are seeking a Treasury Assistant for a 6-month temporary contract (replacement mission) within a prominent financial institution located in the European Quarter of Brussels (1040). Reporting directly to the Head of Treasury, you will play a hands-on role in supporting treasury dealers with their daily market and operational activities.  
 

Main Responsibilities
 
 
 
• Money Market Operations: Executing bank-to-bank transfers and performing market transactions, specifically deposits.

• Multichannel Communication: Handling multiple communication channels simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.   

 
 
•

• Languages: Business fluency in Italian, French, and English is required (listed by order of importance for daily operations).   
 
• IT Skills: Advanced proficiency in Excel (good level required) and familiarity with Bloomberg.   
 
• Soft Skills: You are proactive, dynamic, and possess a positive, social attitude. You are autonomous, excel at managing priorities, and can maintain your calm during intense, deadline-driven situations.

The Company

An industrial group active for several decades in the Brussels periphery, this company produces and markets technical equipment for a European professional client base. Finance is at the heart of operations, with flows crossing multiple countries and stakeholders that vary from one file to the next.

Around a hundred people on site, a well-organised accounting team and a work environment that values autonomy without leaving you on your own. The offices are located near Vilvoorde.

Your Responsibilities

You join the accounting team and take charge of the supplier and client cycle for several group entities.

• Processing and controlling purchase and sales invoices.
• Monitoring payments, reconciling accounts and matching third-party accounts.
• Managing client follow-ups and coordinating with suppliers in English and Dutch.
• Preparing VAT declarations and monitoring current regulatory obligations.
• Participating in monthly and annual closings in support of the team.
• Your responsibilities may evolve over time.

The Ideal Profile

Education : Bachelor's degree in accounting or equivalent through experience.

Experience : Minimum 3 years of experience in accounts payable and/or receivable. You are autonomous on day-to-day tasks and comfortable in a high-volume environment.

Personal qualities

• Organised and reliable, you manage your priorities with method.
• Comfortable in both English and Dutch, you communicate effortlessly with a wide range of counterparts.
• You thrive in environments where you are trusted to work independently.

Our client, a biotech company based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology firm bringing innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. With this, the company makes a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.
They are currently in a phase of strong growth and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members.

Jobomschrijving

Are you looking for a meaningful job where you contribute daily to improving the lives of patients with life-threatening diseases? As a Lab Technician you will work with a passionate team to develop groundbreaking therapies and make a real difference for patients worldwide.

Your key responsibilities:
	
• Work daily in a Class A/B/C/D cleanroom environment and maintain the cleanliness of equipment and facilities.	
• Produce clinical and commercial ATMPs through aseptic manual processes, including cell isolation, selection, activation, transduction, culture, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.	
• Perform in-process control tests on batch samples, ensuring high standards for cell counts and viability.	
• Ensure equipment operates smoothly by following instructions, troubleshooting issues, and coordinating repairs.	
• Contribute to process optimization, including the introduction of new products, procedures, and equipment in GMP areas.	
• Support the writing and review of SOPs and other production-related documents, and manage raw materials, consumables, and waste.

Who we are looking for:
	
• You have obtained a Bachelor's degree in Sciences, Bio-Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, or a related field, or possess equivalent experience.	
• Cell culture experience (internship or work-based) is a strong plus. 	
• Knowledge of GMP regulations is a strong plus.	
• Strong interpersonal skills with a focus on teamwork are required.	
• Clear communication in English with attention to detail.	
• Strong problem-solving abilities with a positive attitude.	
• Motivated to learn independently and coach others.	
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.

As a Customer Service Officer, you are the first point of contact for customers experiencing vehicle breakdowns. Together with a close-knit, multicultural team, you ensure that vehicles—from passenger cars to trucks—are quickly back on the road. You communicate with customers, garages, and all relevant partners to coordinate efficient solutions.
Your day starts by answering incoming calls and emails. You register cases, gather all necessary information, and make sure everything is accurate and complete. You switch quickly between tasks: providing technical support, following up on arrangements with workshops, and keeping customers updated on progress. Specifically:

• You design and build modern data platforms (Azure, Databricks, Data Fabric) with a focus on reusability and AI-readiness.
